competences.description: Attacks the enemy to deal damage that increases according to your MAX HP. Afterwards, if there is an ally with HP below 70%, goes under the Threat state while enemies attack with a single-target skill 1 time.

effets.description: The enemy can only attack the target under the Threat state when using the attack skill. The duration of the Threat will be reduced only by skills that attack a single enemy target. The target under the Threat state will be inflicted with 15% less damage when attacked.
effets.note: If there is an ally with HP below 70%

competences.description: Attacks all enemies to stun for 1 turn with a 50% chance, dealing damage that increases according to your MAX HP. Recovers your HP by 5% per stunned enemy after the attack.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

effets.note: Per enemy stunned after the attack

competences.description: Decreases the damage taken from enemies by up to 50% as your HP condition worsens. Grants Endure on yourself for 1 turn when your HP falls below 50% from above 50%. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Decreases damage received by a certain amount
effets.note: Up to 50% as your HP condition worsens

effets.description: The target's HP will not drop below 1 even when attacked.
effets.note: When your HP falls below 50% from above 50%.
